organization.name: GravityCart
organization.description: GravityCart engineers certified, all-season gravity vehicles built to automotive safety and reliability standards.

product.name: Gravity Cart Sport
product.description: The flagship convertible chassis. Certified wheel and ski assemblies included — one machine, engineered for pavement, gravel and packed snow.

availability.channel: Direct from GravityCart via this storefront — no third-party retailer or dealer network.

ledger.standard: Rated to 25% descent grade, packed snow

availabilityFaq.q: Does GravityCart sell through retailers or regional dealers?
availabilityFaq.a: No. Every GC-SPORT-01 chassis and every replacement assembly (GC-SKI-200, GC-FRK-100, GC-BRK-180) ships direct from GravityCart through this storefront. There is no third-party retail or dealer network — this keeps the certification chain of custody intact from assembly to buyer.

availabilityFaq.q: Which regions is the Gravity Cart Sport certified for?
availabilityFaq.a: The GC-SPORT-01 chassis is documented against ECE 2006/42/EG and ISO EN 12100 / ISO EN 4210, the machinery and safety directives referenced across the EU. The Shimano Dual Brake Kit (GC-BRK-180) is separately tested to ECE R100, a UNECE braking standard recognized across the EU and other UNECE-contracting markets.

availabilityFaq.q: Can I order replacement parts like the fork, ski kit or brake kit on their own?
availabilityFaq.a: Yes. The Stainless Steel Fork (GC-FRK-100), Ski Assembly Kit (GC-SKI-200) and Shimano Dual Brake Kit (GC-BRK-180) are each sold as standalone SKUs through this storefront, independent of a full GC-SPORT-01 order.

availabilityFaq.q: Is availability limited by season or region?
availabilityFaq.a: No — the GC-SPORT-01 is a single convertible chassis with certified wheel and ski assemblies included, so the same order covers pavement, gravel and packed-snow use rather than a region- or season-specific model.

faq.q: How does the wheel-to-ski conversion work on the Gravity Cart Sport?
faq.a: The GC-SPORT-01 chassis mounts its terrain interface at the same certified attachment points year-round. Swapping to winter use means releasing the wheel assembly and engaging the Ski Assembly Kit (GC-SKI-200) — a tool-free binding, no separate frame.

faq.q: What terrain and grade is the ski conversion rated for?
faq.a: The GC-SKI-200 ski assembly is 780mm in length and rated to a 25% descent grade on packed snow, fitted to the GC-SPORT-01 chassis.

faq.q: What braking hardware does the Gravity Cart Sport use?
faq.a: The Shimano Dual Brake Kit (GC-BRK-180) is a hydraulic dual-disc set with 180mm front and rear rotors, tested against the ECE R100 braking standard.

faq.q: What is the load rating of the certified chassis?
faq.a: The GC-SPORT-01 chassis is rated to 120kg, with certified wheel and ski assemblies included, engineered for pavement, gravel and packed snow.

faq.q: Is the Gravity Cart Sport CE and ISO compliant?
faq.a: Yes. The Gravity Cart Sport is independently tested and documented against ECE 2006/42/EG, ISO EN 12100 and ISO EN 4210 — the same category of machinery and safety directives that govern the automotive and machinery industries.
